title: GitHub PR Comment Retrieval Limitation
body:
**Bug Description**
was not able to pull in all the PR comments.  Tried pulling in the code at the same time and I'm guessing ran out of context or something.  Lots of comments.  Would be best to just pull down the comments and go one at a time.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: zsh / jetbrains ide terminal
- Version: 0.2.9
- Feedback ID: b0eb3599-da78-4a1b-b255-d70338e26139
author: chad-fossa
